newsitem.title: USA: Vista 2000 sells unit for $2.0 mln.
newsitem.headline: Vista 2000 sells unit for $2.0 mln.

text.p: Vista 2000 Inc said Friday it has sold its unit, Alabaster Industries Inc to W.R. Hill & Co for $2.0 million.

It said W.R. Hill paid for the unit with $500,000 in cash and $1.5 million in a note, secured by a first mortgage on the land and buildings comprising Alabaster's manufacturing, sales and administrative operations.
Vista said it expects to take a loss of about $1.8 million on the sale of Alabaster, which represents about eight percent of its consolidated revenues in 1996.
Vista cited Alabaster's continuing losses as a reason for the sale.
